credits.title: A Figment of Your Imagination
credits.overview: A gifted college freshman comes of age, stumbles upon the bizarre allure of a clandestine theatre club and falls in love with her sleep paralysis demon, while the weight of caring for her ailing mother casts a shadow over her blossoming journey of self-discovery.

credits.title: Red Zone: Dead City
credits.overview: Two weeks after a devastating zombie outbreak destroys their home, a resilient young woman and her band of refugees flee to a neighboring safe zone, only to be hunted by paranoid locals convinced the outsiders are harboring the lethal virus.

credits.title: The Sea Speaks His Name
credits.overview: Set during the volatile final months of Indonesia's New Order regime, the narrative chronicles a young student activist's perilous commitment to pro-democracy underground movements and his family's subsequent, grueling quest for justice following his forced disappearance.

credits.title: Ghost in the Cell
credits.overview: In a notorious prison, an invisible force begins killing inmates brutally, compelling enemy gangs and corrupt guards to work together as they try to survive the mounting bloodshed.

credits.title: Dopamine
credits.overview: A young couple facing eviction and debt experiences an unexpected event that changes their lives.

credits.title: Bestiary
credits.overview: In a film about monsters, an actor’s greatest enemy is his own grief, a beast that grows stronger with every scene.

credits.title: Midnight in Bali
credits.overview: Other than her hugely popular shows at one of Bali’s favourite gay bars, life isn’t exactly going to plan for trans performer Bulan. After meeting aspiring filmmaker Lily, however, Bulan starts to address her pain and anger. The result is both shocking and cathartic.
